environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a public subnet. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Flask application runs directly via gunicorn. Instance role has no relevance to the SQL injection but the database contains sensitive api_key column accessible via UNION-based injection.

config.database: local SQLite with api_key column in users table
